events.title: Requests exceed the limit
events.detail: Repurchase requests exceeded the plan's limits. BREIT filled 43% of requested repurchases.

events.title: 4% of requests filled
events.detail: BREIT filled 4% of requested repurchases in December 2022.

events.title: 88% of requests filled
events.detail: Requests exceeded the monthly limit. BREIT repurchased 2% of NAV, which was 88% of requests.

events.title: All requests filled
events.detail: Requests fell below the limits and every request was filled.

events.title: Board exceeds the quarterly limit
events.detail: The board approved repurchases 0.1% above the 5% quarterly limit so that all March requests could be filled.

events.title: Every request filled, February to December
events.detail: BREIT reports filling all repurchase requests received from February through December 2024.

events.title: Limit raised to 7%
events.detail: The board raised the quarterly amount above 5% and filled 100% of requests, repurchasing 7.0% of shares.

source.name: BCRED letter to investors, June 4, 2026 (SEC filing)

events.title: Requests prorated at 5%
events.detail: Requests reached about 10% of shares. BCRED repurchased 5.0%, filling requests pro rata: roughly half of the $4.5 billion requested.

events.title: Prorated again in Q3
events.detail: Requests of about $4.3 billion, roughly 10% of shares; BCRED said it would fill 5%. It estimated that investors who asked in Q2 and Q3 would receive about 75% of what they requested within about 90 days.
